1.description: Vigor now gives 20 extra energy, from 10.

1.description: Mutilate now does 10% reduced damage in pvp, before it had no modifier.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: Meditate now restores 6%/12%/18%/24%/30% base mana per combo point, before it was 3%/6%/9%/12%/15% maximum mana per combo point.

1.description: Master of Subtlety now lasts for 10 seconds, from 6.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: Eviserate now does 15% reduced damage in pvp, changed from 10%

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: Aggression now increases the critical strike chance of Sinister Strike and Eviscerate, but no longer increases their damage.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: The proc effect of Seal of Justice has been changed from a stun to an immobilize.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: The Nature's Grasp root has been reduced to last for 5 seconds, from 10.

1.author: Vladamir(598177550082113536)
1.description: Blazing Speed now gives you a 33/66/100% chance when taking damage that takes you below 35% health or while being below 35% health to increase your movement speed by 50% and dispel all movement impairing effects. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can only occur every 30 seconds.

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
4.description: [Andorhal]: Arena system has been reworked. We are making the finishing touches on wargames and high-risk arenas. There are also rewards for playing arenas now.

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
4.description: [Andorhal]: Scroll of resolution has been removed from all characters. There is now a hefty reward for completing the x1 xp challenge if you start it from level 1. Including a new exclusive mount.

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
4.description: [Andorhal]: Transmog System has been reworked. It is now conformed into a slot-based system. This system is being finished and all transmogs will return once it is complete.

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
4.description: [Andorhal]: High warlord weapons no longer cost rank 14 to purchase. However, they are now available for arena points and no longer honor.

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
4.description: [Andorhal]: With the arena system rework. We have added many items and many more to come into the progression vendors. There are 5 PVP progression seasons, not to be confused with our seasonal realms. Andorhal is currently in the 4th PVP progression. The 5th PVP Progression will unlock many more items. Stay tuned!

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
4.description: [Andorhal]: Reworked the balancing of teams in Battlegrounds.

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)

4.author: Grey(535641729953431582)
4.description: [Andorhal]: Implemented an arena cap bar that will show you how many arena points you have earned and can earn until the next flush.
